description: This file defines the NoteListAdapter class, an Android adapter that renders Note items within a ListView in the MainActivity of an app. It manages data display, view inflation, and data binding for Note objects.

classes.name: NoteListAdapter
classes.description: An Android ArrayAdapter subclass that handles displaying Note objects in a ListView within MainActivity.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with new Note list and notifies the view to refresh.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of Note items managed by the adapter.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves the Note at the specified position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or updates a view for a Note item at a given position, binding Note fields to the corresponding UI elements.
